degree_rationale: Five great Things established in the bodies of the strong archons — the disc on the Omophoros, the Pillar's foreparts, gehennas, sea pillars, the four walls. Essential structural completing of cosmos.
direction_rationale: Structural ultimating — the foundational pillars and walls of cosmos set in place through the bodies of subjugated archons. Western-completing.
grand_man_function: Celestial structural-pillars — outermost foundations of celestial order.
title: The Five Works built in the bodies of the strong archons
